CSS uses var(--vscode-foreground), var(--vscode-editor-background), var(--vscode-font-family), var(--vscode-panel-border), etc. JS getThemeColors() reads --vscode-foreground, --vscode-editor-background, --vscode-charts-blue, --vscode-charts-green, --vscode-charts-red, --vscode-charts-yellow
Webview calls vscode.setState(state) in persistState() and const previousState = vscode.getState() on load. Also sends saveState message to extension host which stores history in this._history.
